build.testCommand:
gh pr create --base main --head refactor/document-generation --title "Document generation pipeline + benchmark v2 redesign" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

This branch turns the BioGuider document-generation pipeline into a measurable system. Two halves:

1. **Generation pipeline refactor** (Phase 1–2.5 across many commits) — breaks the monolithic generation manager into small composable components in `bioguider/generation/` (loader, suggestion extractor, repo reader, style analyzer, change planner, document renderer, LLM cleaner, output manager, etc.).
2. **Benchmark v2 redesign** (today, 2026-04-29 → 2026-04-30) — rebuilds the evaluator after a reviewer audit found 4 bugs that distorted previous E001/E002 results. Adds two new metrics, fixes the link scorer, unifies evaluation codepaths, expands the model roster from 5 → 11 verified-real models.

## What changed in benchmark v2 (the high-value part)

### Evaluator fixes
- **Precision is real now** (was structurally locked at 1.0). New `count_collateral_damage()` does deterministic FP detection via `difflib.SequenceMatcher` line-level diff — no LLM call needed.
- **Link scorer fixed** — was returning fix-rate=100% because it counted any well-formed link as a fix. Now checks the specific injected snippet.
- **Headline = sum-of-categories** (was diverging 40 vs 46 due to two evaluation codepaths). Unified to one source of truth in `evaluate_fixes()`.
- **Propagation chain fixed** — `false_positives`, `code_fence_violations`, `yaml_violations`, `section_violations` now flow from `BenchmarkResult` → `StressLevelResult` → JSON/CSV. Locked in by `tests/test_stress_result_propagation.py`.

### New metrics
- **Hard FP** — protected-region violations (code fences, YAML, section headers). Caught by `check_protected_regions()`.
- **Soft FP** — collateral damage outside known error sites and protected regions.

### Prompt + model lock
- BioGuider prompt → v3 (4 evaluation dimensions + ground-truth methodology).
- Generic prompt → true one-liner (was leaking eval rubric).
- Skill tests locked to `gpt-4o` for reproducibility.

### MODELS roster expanded 5 → 11
Added `gpt-5.2`, `gpt-5.3-codex`, `gpt-5.4-nano`, `kimi-k2.6`, `minimax-m2.5`, `deepseek-v4-flash`. Excluded the proxy's `claude-*` aliases (they secretly route to Kimi) and `deepseek-v3.2` (claims to be Claude). Real Claude requires direct Anthropic API.

## Results post-redesign

| Hypothesis | Outcome | Magnitude |
|---|---|---|
| BioGuider F1 ≥ Generic | ✅ Confirmed (E002-v2 + E003) | +2.36pp F1_scorable |
| BioGuider duration < Generic | ❌ Refuted | Generic ~10% faster |
| BioGuider violations < Generic | ✅ Confirmed | -19.8% protected-region violations |
| Old E001 model ranking | 🔄 Reversed (de_vignette only) | gpt-oss #1, gpt-4o #3 (was #1) |

- `tests/test_benchmark_protection.py` — 15 unit tests for new metrics
